scope: Second-round independent adversarial code review of build-go W1 pilot; issues & gaps identified and fixed with TDD
findings_fixed: FATAL BUG: sidecar.AssetPath sliced raw bundle path (bundle[:len(bundle)-len(ext)]), corrupting trailing-slash and relative paths (e.g. 'style.css/' -> 'style..asset.php', 'dir/bundle.js/' -> 'dir/bundle.j.asset.php'); fixed by trimming trailing separators and reconstructing via filepath.Join(dir, stem+'.asset.php') matching Node path.join(path.dirname, ...)
FATAL BUG: covercheck.parseBlock required len(fields) == 3, failing on any path containing spaces; fixed by taking the last two fields as stmts and count and joining all preceding fields
CROSS-PLATFORM BUG: covercheck.Evaluate used path.Dir on Windows backslash paths, returning '.' because path only splits on '/'; fixed by normalizing with strings.ReplaceAll(file, '\\', '/')

NUMERIC DIVERGENCE: phpencode.jsNumber and config.jsFloat produced '-0' for negative zero (-0.0), whereas JS (-0).toString() and json2php(-0.0) strictly produce '0'; fixed with zero guard (if t == 0 { return '0' })
FALSY DIVERGENCE: config.truthy treated math.NaN() and json.Number zero values ('0.0', '-0', '0.00', '-0.0') as truthy; updated to evaluate via Float64() checking !math.IsNaN(f) && f != 0
PRECISION GAP: phpencode.encode did not check strconv.ParseUint for json.Number, losing precision on uint64 values exceeding math.MaxInt64; added ParseUint check before float fallback
CLEANUP: Removed dead math constants (_ = math.MinInt64, _ = math.MaxInt64) in phpencode.go

verification.binary_e2e: wpdev-build hash, config, and sidecar verified against live repo files

commands: cd packages/build-go && go vet ./... && gofmt -l . && go test -count=1 ./... && go test -count=1 -race -shuffle=on ./... && go test -count=1 -cover ./...
